    OR = {
        AND = {
            check_modifier_value = {
                modifier = planet_jobs_trade_produces_add
                value > 0
            }
        }
    }
}

                modifier = planet_jobs_unity_produces_add

            }

bca_jr_should_dec_archivist = {
    NOR = {
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_archivist_physics_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_physics_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_archivist_engineering_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_engineering_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_archivist_society_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_society_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_archivist_food = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_food = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_archivist_consumer_goods = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_consumer_goods = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_archivist_rare_crystals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_rare_crystals = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_archivist_energy = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_energy = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_archivist_unity = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_unity = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_archivist_exotic_gases = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_exotic_gases = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_archivist_alloys = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_alloys = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_archivist_volatile_motes = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_volatile_motes = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_archivist_trade = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_trade = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_archivist_minerals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_minerals = yes }
        }
    }
}

            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_physics_research = yes }
        }

            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_volatile_motes = yes }
        }
        AND = {

            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_food = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_artificer_prison_worker_engineering_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_engineering_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_artificer_prison_worker_exotic_gases = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_exotic_gases = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_artificer_prison_worker_alloys = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_alloys = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_artificer_prison_worker_unity = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_unity = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_artificer_prison_worker_minerals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_minerals = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_artificer_prison_worker_trade = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_trade = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_artificer_prison_worker_society_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_society_research = yes }

            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_physics_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_artisan_prison_worker_volatile_motes = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_volatile_motes = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_artisan_prison_worker_food = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_food = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_artisan_prison_worker_engineering_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_engineering_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_artisan_prison_worker_exotic_gases = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_exotic_gases = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_artisan_prison_worker_alloys = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_alloys = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_artisan_prison_worker_unity = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_unity = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_artisan_prison_worker_minerals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_minerals = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_artisan_prison_worker_trade = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_trade = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_artisan_prison_worker_society_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_society_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_artisan_prison_worker_rare_crystals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_rare_crystals = yes }
        }

    OR = {
        AND = {
            check_modifier_value = {
                modifier = planet_jobs_consumer_goods_produces_add
                value > 0
            }
        }
    }
}
# bath_attendant → trade 全部产出均有条件，需满足任一 trigger


bca_jr_has_output_bath_attendant_trade = {
    OR = {
        AND = {
            owner = {
                is_megacorp = yes
            }
        }
    }
}

bca_jr_should_dec_bath_attendant = {
    NOR = {
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_bath_attendant_trade = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_trade = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_bath_attendant_physics_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_physics_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_bath_attendant_food = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_food = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_bath_attendant_consumer_goods = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_consumer_goods = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_bath_attendant_engineering_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_engineering_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_bath_attendant_rare_crystals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_rare_crystals = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_bath_attendant_energy = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_energy = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_bath_attendant_unity = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_unity = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_bath_attendant_exotic_gases = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_exotic_gases = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_bath_attendant_alloys = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_alloys = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_bath_attendant_volatile_motes = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_volatile_motes = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_bath_attendant_society_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_society_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_bath_attendant_minerals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_minerals = yes }
        }
    }
}

bca_jr_should_dec_calculator_biologist = {
    NOR = {
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_calculator_biologist_society_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_society_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_calculator_biologist_physics_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_physics_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_calculator_biologist_consumer_goods = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_consumer_goods = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_calculator_biologist_engineering_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_engineering_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_calculator_biologist_minerals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_minerals = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_calculator_biologist_volatile_motes = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_volatile_motes = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_calculator_biologist_exotic_gases = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_exotic_gases = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_calculator_biologist_food = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_food = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_calculator_biologist_alloys = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_alloys = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_calculator_biologist_energy = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_energy = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_calculator_biologist_rare_crystals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_rare_crystals = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_calculator_biologist_trade = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_trade = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_calculator_biologist_unity = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_unity = yes }
        }
    }
}

# calculator_physicist → physics_research 全部产出均有条件，需满足任一 trigger


bca_jr_has_output_calculator_physicist_physics_research = {
    OR = {
        AND = {
            colony = {
                physicist_is_extradimensional_research_unit_trigger = no
            }
        }
        AND = {
            colony = {
                physicist_is_astrometeorologist_trigger = yes
                solar_system = {
                    OR = {
                        has_environmental_effects = yes
                        has_star_flag = storm_system
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        AND = {
            colony = {
                physicist_is_extradimensional_research_unit_trigger = yes
            }
        }
        AND = {
            physicist_is_space_time_researcher_trigger = yes
        }
    }
}

    OR = {
        AND = {
            check_modifier_value = {
                modifier = planet_jobs_engineering_research_produces_add
                value > 0
            }
        }
    }
}

bca_jr_should_dec_clip_maximizer = {
    NOR = {
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_clip_maximizer_consumer_goods = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_consumer_goods = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_clip_maximizer_physics_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_physics_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_clip_maximizer_food = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_food = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_clip_maximizer_engineering_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_engineering_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_clip_maximizer_rare_crystals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_rare_crystals = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_clip_maximizer_energy = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_energy = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_clip_maximizer_unity = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_unity = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_clip_maximizer_exotic_gases = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_exotic_gases = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_clip_maximizer_alloys = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_alloys = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_clip_maximizer_volatile_motes = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_volatile_motes = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_clip_maximizer_trade = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_trade = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_clip_maximizer_society_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_society_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_clip_maximizer_minerals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_minerals = yes }
        }
    }
}
# colonist → energy 全部产出均有条件，需满足任一 trigger


bca_jr_has_output_colonist_energy = {
    OR = {
        AND = {
            exists = owner
            owner = {
                is_individual_machine = yes
            }
        }
    }
}
# colonist → minerals 全部产出均有条件，需满足任一 trigger


bca_jr_has_output_colonist_minerals = {
    OR = {
        AND = {
            exists = owner
            owner = {
                is_lithoid_empire = yes
            }
        }
    }
}
# colonist → food 全部产出均有条件，需满足任一 trigger


bca_jr_has_output_colonist_food = {
    OR = {
        AND = {
            exists = owner
            owner = {
                is_lithoid_empire = no
                is_infernal_empire = no
                is_individual_machine = no
            }
        }
    }
}

bca_jr_should_dec_cruise_crew_overseer = {
    NOR = {
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_cruise_crew_overseer_unity = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_unity = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_cruise_crew_overseer_trade = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_trade = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_cruise_crew_overseer_engineering_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_engineering_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_cruise_crew_overseer_rare_crystals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_rare_crystals = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_cruise_crew_overseer_minerals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_minerals = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_cruise_crew_overseer_exotic_gases = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_exotic_gases = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_cruise_crew_overseer_consumer_goods = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_consumer_goods = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_cruise_crew_overseer_energy = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_energy = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_cruise_crew_overseer_food = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_food = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_cruise_crew_overseer_physics_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_physics_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_cruise_crew_overseer_volatile_motes = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_volatile_motes = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_cruise_crew_overseer_society_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_society_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_cruise_crew_overseer_alloys = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_alloys = yes }
        }
    }
}

bca_jr_should_dec_cruise_passenger = {
    NOR = {
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_cruise_passenger_unity = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_unity = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_cruise_passenger_trade = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_trade = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_cruise_passenger_rare_crystals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_rare_crystals = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_cruise_passenger_society_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_society_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_cruise_passenger_food = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_food = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_cruise_passenger_alloys = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_alloys = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_cruise_passenger_energy = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_energy = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_cruise_passenger_exotic_gases = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_exotic_gases = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_cruise_passenger_engineering_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_engineering_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_cruise_passenger_volatile_motes = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_volatile_motes = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_cruise_passenger_physics_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_physics_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_cruise_passenger_consumer_goods = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_consumer_goods = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_cruise_passenger_minerals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_minerals = yes }
        }
    }
}
# cruise_passenger_unemployment → energy 全部产出均有条件，需满足任一 trigger


bca_jr_has_output_cruise_passenger_unemployment_energy = {
    OR = {
        AND = {
            check_modifier_value = {
                modifier = planet_cruise_passengers_energy_produces_add
                value > 0
            }
        }
    }
}

bca_jr_should_dec_cyberdome_spectator = {
    NOR = {
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_cyberdome_spectator_energy = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_energy = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_cyberdome_spectator_trade = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_trade = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_cyberdome_spectator_physics_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_physics_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_cyberdome_spectator_food = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_food = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_cyberdome_spectator_consumer_goods = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_consumer_goods = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_cyberdome_spectator_engineering_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_engineering_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_cyberdome_spectator_rare_crystals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_rare_crystals = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_cyberdome_spectator_unity = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_unity = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_cyberdome_spectator_exotic_gases = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_exotic_gases = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_cyberdome_spectator_alloys = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_alloys = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_cyberdome_spectator_volatile_motes = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_volatile_motes = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_cyberdome_spectator_society_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_society_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_cyberdome_spectator_minerals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_minerals = yes }
        }
    }
}

bca_jr_should_dec_dimensional_portal_researcher_gestalt = {
    NOR = {
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_dimensional_portal_researcher_gestalt_physics_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_physics_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_dimensional_portal_researcher_gestalt_energy = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_energy = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_dimensional_portal_researcher_gestalt_food = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_food = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_dimensional_portal_researcher_gestalt_consumer_goods = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_consumer_goods = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_dimensional_portal_researcher_gestalt_engineering_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_engineering_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_dimensional_portal_researcher_gestalt_rare_crystals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_rare_crystals = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_dimensional_portal_researcher_gestalt_unity = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_unity = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_dimensional_portal_researcher_gestalt_exotic_gases = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_exotic_gases = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_dimensional_portal_researcher_gestalt_alloys = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_alloys = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_dimensional_portal_researcher_gestalt_volatile_motes = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_volatile_motes = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_dimensional_portal_researcher_gestalt_trade = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_trade = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_dimensional_portal_researcher_gestalt_society_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_society_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_dimensional_portal_researcher_gestalt_minerals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_minerals = yes }
        }
    }
}

        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_drone_wrangler_unity = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_unity = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_drone_wrangler_food = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_food = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_drone_wrangler_trade = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_trade = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_drone_wrangler_engineering_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_engineering_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_drone_wrangler_rare_crystals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_rare_crystals = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_drone_wrangler_volatile_motes = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_volatile_motes = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_drone_wrangler_energy = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_energy = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_drone_wrangler_consumer_goods = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_consumer_goods = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_drone_wrangler_exotic_gases = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_exotic_gases = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_drone_wrangler_alloys = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_alloys = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_drone_wrangler_minerals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_minerals = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_drone_wrangler_physics_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_physics_research = yes }
        }
    }

bca_jr_should_dec_dystopian_telepath = {
    NOR = {
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_dystopian_telepath_unity = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_unity = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_dystopian_telepath_physics_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_physics_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_dystopian_telepath_engineering_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_engineering_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_dystopian_telepath_society_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_society_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_dystopian_telepath_food = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_food = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_dystopian_telepath_volatile_motes = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_volatile_motes = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_dystopian_telepath_rare_crystals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_rare_crystals = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_dystopian_telepath_trade = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_trade = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_dystopian_telepath_minerals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_minerals = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_dystopian_telepath_energy = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_energy = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_dystopian_telepath_alloys = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_alloys = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_dystopian_telepath_exotic_gases = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_exotic_gases = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_dystopian_telepath_consumer_goods = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_consumer_goods = yes }
        }
    }
}

bca_jr_should_dec_event_purge = {
    NOR = {
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_event_purge_unity = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_unity = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_event_purge_society_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_society_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_event_purge_physics_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_physics_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_event_purge_food = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_food = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_event_purge_consumer_goods = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_consumer_goods = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_event_purge_engineering_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_engineering_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_event_purge_rare_crystals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_rare_crystals = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_event_purge_energy = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_energy = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_event_purge_exotic_gases = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_exotic_gases = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_event_purge_alloys = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_alloys = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_event_purge_volatile_motes = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_volatile_motes = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_event_purge_trade = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_trade = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_event_purge_minerals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_minerals = yes }
        }
    }
}

bca_jr_should_dec_fe_acolyte_generator = {
    NOR = {
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_fe_acolyte_generator_energy = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_energy = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_fe_acolyte_generator_volatile_motes = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_volatile_motes = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_fe_acolyte_generator_alloys = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_alloys = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_fe_acolyte_generator_exotic_gases = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_exotic_gases = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_fe_acolyte_generator_unity = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_unity = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_fe_acolyte_generator_consumer_goods = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_consumer_goods = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_fe_acolyte_generator_trade = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_trade = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_fe_acolyte_generator_society_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_society_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_fe_acolyte_generator_physics_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_physics_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_fe_acolyte_generator_engineering_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_engineering_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_fe_acolyte_generator_food = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_food = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_fe_acolyte_generator_minerals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_minerals = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_fe_acolyte_generator_rare_crystals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_rare_crystals = yes }
        }
    }
}
# fe_acolyte_mine → energy 全部产出均有条件，需满足任一 trigger


bca_jr_has_output_fe_acolyte_mine_energy = {
    OR = {
        AND = {
            check_modifier_value = {
                modifier = planet_miners_energy_produces_add
                value > 0
            }
        }
    }
}

    NOR = {
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_fe_augur_unity = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_unity = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_fe_augur_physics_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_physics_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_fe_augur_food = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_food = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_fe_augur_consumer_goods = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_consumer_goods = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_fe_augur_engineering_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_engineering_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_fe_augur_rare_crystals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_rare_crystals = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_fe_augur_energy = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_energy = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_fe_augur_exotic_gases = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_exotic_gases = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_fe_augur_alloys = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_alloys = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_fe_augur_volatile_motes = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_volatile_motes = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_fe_augur_trade = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_trade = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_fe_augur_society_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_society_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_fe_augur_minerals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_minerals = yes }
        }
    }
}

            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_consumer_goods = yes }
        }

            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_engineering_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {

            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_rare_crystals = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_gas_refiner_drone_energy = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_energy = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_gas_refiner_drone_unity = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_unity = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_gas_refiner_drone_alloys = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_alloys = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_gas_refiner_drone_volatile_motes = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_volatile_motes = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_gas_refiner_drone_trade = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_trade = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_gas_refiner_drone_society_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_society_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_gas_refiner_drone_minerals = yes

bca_jr_should_dec_hive_basic_agri_drone_lithoid = {
    NOR = {
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_hive_basic_agri_drone_lithoid_minerals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_minerals = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_hive_basic_agri_drone_lithoid_food = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_food = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_hive_basic_agri_drone_lithoid_physics_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_physics_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_hive_basic_agri_drone_lithoid_alloys = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_alloys = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_hive_basic_agri_drone_lithoid_volatile_motes = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_volatile_motes = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_hive_basic_agri_drone_lithoid_unity = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_unity = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_hive_basic_agri_drone_lithoid_consumer_goods = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_consumer_goods = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_hive_basic_agri_drone_lithoid_society_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_society_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_hive_basic_agri_drone_lithoid_exotic_gases = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_exotic_gases = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_hive_basic_agri_drone_lithoid_rare_crystals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_rare_crystals = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_hive_basic_agri_drone_lithoid_engineering_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_engineering_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_hive_basic_agri_drone_lithoid_energy = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_energy = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_hive_basic_agri_drone_lithoid_trade = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_trade = yes }
        }
    }
}

bca_jr_should_dec_hunter_gatherer = {
    NOR = {
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_hunter_gatherer_food = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_food = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_hunter_gatherer_physics_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_physics_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_hunter_gatherer_alloys = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_alloys = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_hunter_gatherer_volatile_motes = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_volatile_motes = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_hunter_gatherer_unity = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_unity = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_hunter_gatherer_consumer_goods = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_consumer_goods = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_hunter_gatherer_minerals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_minerals = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_hunter_gatherer_society_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_society_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_hunter_gatherer_exotic_gases = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_exotic_gases = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_hunter_gatherer_rare_crystals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_rare_crystals = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_hunter_gatherer_engineering_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_engineering_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_hunter_gatherer_energy = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_energy = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_hunter_gatherer_trade = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_trade = yes }
        }
    }
}

bca_jr_should_dec_low_tech_farmer = {
    NOR = {
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_low_tech_farmer_food = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_food = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_low_tech_farmer_physics_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_physics_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_low_tech_farmer_alloys = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_alloys = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_low_tech_farmer_volatile_motes = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_volatile_motes = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_low_tech_farmer_unity = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_unity = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_low_tech_farmer_consumer_goods = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_consumer_goods = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_low_tech_farmer_minerals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_minerals = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_low_tech_farmer_society_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_society_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_low_tech_farmer_exotic_gases = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_exotic_gases = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_low_tech_farmer_rare_crystals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_rare_crystals = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_low_tech_farmer_engineering_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_engineering_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_low_tech_farmer_energy = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_energy = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_low_tech_farmer_trade = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_trade = yes }
        }
    }
}

        bca_jr_has_output_low_tech_manager_minerals = yes
    }
}


bca_jr_should_inc_low_tech_manager_for_food = {
    OR = {
        bca_jr_has_output_low_tech_manager_food = yes
    }
}


bca_jr_should_inc_low_tech_manager_for_physics_research = {
    OR = {
        bca_jr_has_output_low_tech_manager_physics_research = yes
    }
}


bca_jr_should_dec_low_tech_manager = {
    NOR = {
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_low_tech_manager_unity = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_unity = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_low_tech_manager_trade = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_trade = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_low_tech_manager_society_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_society_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_low_tech_manager_engineering_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_engineering_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_low_tech_manager_rare_crystals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_rare_crystals = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_low_tech_manager_volatile_motes = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_volatile_motes = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_low_tech_manager_energy = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_energy = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_low_tech_manager_consumer_goods = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_consumer_goods = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_low_tech_manager_exotic_gases = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_exotic_gases = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_low_tech_manager_alloys = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_alloys = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_low_tech_manager_minerals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_minerals = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_low_tech_manager_food = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_food = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_low_tech_manager_physics_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_physics_research = yes }
        }
    }
}
# low_tech_miner → energy 全部产出均有条件，需满足任一 trigger


bca_jr_has_output_low_tech_miner_energy = {
    OR = {
        AND = {
            check_modifier_value = {
                modifier = planet_miners_energy_produces_add
                value > 0
            }
        }
    }
}

    NOR = {
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_mineral_diver_drone_minerals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_minerals = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_mineral_diver_drone_alloys = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_alloys = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_mineral_diver_drone_food = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_food = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_mineral_diver_drone_volatile_motes = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_volatile_motes = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_mineral_diver_drone_rare_crystals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_rare_crystals = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_mineral_diver_drone_engineering_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_engineering_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_mineral_diver_drone_energy = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_energy = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_mineral_diver_drone_physics_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_physics_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_mineral_diver_drone_society_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_society_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_mineral_diver_drone_trade = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_trade = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_mineral_diver_drone_consumer_goods = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_consumer_goods = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_mineral_diver_drone_unity = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_unity = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_mineral_diver_drone_exotic_gases = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_exotic_gases = yes }
        }
    }
}

            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_physics_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_munitions_decommissioning_unit_food = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_food = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_munitions_decommissioning_unit_consumer_goods = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_consumer_goods = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_munitions_decommissioning_unit_rare_crystals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_rare_crystals = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_munitions_decommissioning_unit_energy = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_energy = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_munitions_decommissioning_unit_unity = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_unity = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_munitions_decommissioning_unit_exotic_gases = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_exotic_gases = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_munitions_decommissioning_unit_volatile_motes = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_volatile_motes = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_munitions_decommissioning_unit_trade = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_trade = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_munitions_decommissioning_unit_society_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_society_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_munitions_decommissioning_unit_minerals = yes

bca_jr_should_dec_neural_chip = {
    NOR = {
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_neural_chip_society_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_society_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_neural_chip_engineering_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_engineering_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_neural_chip_physics_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_physics_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_neural_chip_rare_crystals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_rare_crystals = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_neural_chip_exotic_gases = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_exotic_gases = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_neural_chip_minerals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_minerals = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_neural_chip_food = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_food = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_neural_chip_consumer_goods = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_consumer_goods = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_neural_chip_alloys = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_alloys = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_neural_chip_trade = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_trade = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_neural_chip_energy = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_energy = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_neural_chip_volatile_motes = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_volatile_motes = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_neural_chip_unity = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_unity = yes }
        }
    }
}
# odd_factory_drone → energy 全部产出均有条件，需满足任一 trigger

bca_jr_should_dec_organic_battery = {
    NOR = {
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_organic_battery_energy = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_energy = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_organic_battery_physics_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_physics_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_organic_battery_food = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_food = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_organic_battery_consumer_goods = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_consumer_goods = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_organic_battery_engineering_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_engineering_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_organic_battery_rare_crystals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_rare_crystals = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_organic_battery_unity = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_unity = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_organic_battery_exotic_gases = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_exotic_gases = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_organic_battery_alloys = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_alloys = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_organic_battery_volatile_motes = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_volatile_motes = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_organic_battery_trade = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_trade = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_organic_battery_society_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_society_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_organic_battery_minerals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_minerals = yes }
        }
    }
}

            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_consumer_goods = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_overlord_bio_trophy_drone_engineering_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_engineering_research = yes }
        }

            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_rare_crystals = yes }

            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_energy = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_overlord_bio_trophy_drone_exotic_gases = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_exotic_gases = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_overlord_bio_trophy_drone_alloys = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_alloys = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_overlord_bio_trophy_drone_volatile_motes = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_volatile_motes = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_overlord_bio_trophy_drone_trade = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_trade = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_overlord_bio_trophy_drone_society_research = yes

        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_overlord_mortal_initiate_unity = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_unity = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_overlord_mortal_initiate_society_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_society_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_overlord_mortal_initiate_physics_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_physics_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_overlord_mortal_initiate_food = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_food = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_overlord_mortal_initiate_consumer_goods = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_consumer_goods = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_overlord_mortal_initiate_engineering_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_engineering_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_overlord_mortal_initiate_rare_crystals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_rare_crystals = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_overlord_mortal_initiate_energy = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_energy = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_overlord_mortal_initiate_exotic_gases = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_exotic_gases = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_overlord_mortal_initiate_alloys = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_alloys = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_overlord_mortal_initiate_volatile_motes = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_volatile_motes = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_overlord_mortal_initiate_trade = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_trade = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_overlord_mortal_initiate_minerals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_minerals = yes }
        }
    }
}

bca_jr_should_dec_patrol_drone = {
    NOR = {
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_patrol_drone_unity = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_unity = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_patrol_drone_physics_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_physics_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_patrol_drone_food = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_food = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_patrol_drone_consumer_goods = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_consumer_goods = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_patrol_drone_engineering_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_engineering_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_patrol_drone_rare_crystals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_rare_crystals = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_patrol_drone_energy = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_energy = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_patrol_drone_exotic_gases = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_exotic_gases = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_patrol_drone_alloys = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_alloys = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_patrol_drone_volatile_motes = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_volatile_motes = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_patrol_drone_trade = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_trade = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_patrol_drone_society_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_society_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_patrol_drone_minerals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_minerals = yes }
        }
    }
}

bca_jr_should_dec_primitive_administrator = {
    NOR = {
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_primitive_administrator_unity = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_unity = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_primitive_administrator_society_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_society_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_primitive_administrator_trade = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_trade = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_primitive_administrator_engineering_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_engineering_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_primitive_administrator_rare_crystals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_rare_crystals = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_primitive_administrator_volatile_motes = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_volatile_motes = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_primitive_administrator_energy = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_energy = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_primitive_administrator_consumer_goods = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_consumer_goods = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_primitive_administrator_exotic_gases = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_exotic_gases = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_primitive_administrator_alloys = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_alloys = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_primitive_administrator_minerals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_minerals = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_primitive_administrator_food = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_food = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_primitive_administrator_physics_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_physics_research = yes }
        }
    }
}

            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_energy = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_primitive_hive_factory_drone_physics_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_physics_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_primitive_hive_factory_drone_volatile_motes = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_volatile_motes = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_primitive_hive_factory_drone_food = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_food = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_primitive_hive_factory_drone_engineering_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_engineering_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_primitive_hive_factory_drone_exotic_gases = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_exotic_gases = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_primitive_hive_factory_drone_unity = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_unity = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_primitive_hive_factory_drone_minerals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_minerals = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_primitive_hive_factory_drone_trade = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_trade = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_primitive_hive_factory_drone_society_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_society_research = yes }

        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_primitive_hive_miner_minerals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_minerals = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_primitive_hive_miner_food = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_food = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_primitive_hive_miner_alloys = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_alloys = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_primitive_hive_miner_volatile_motes = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_volatile_motes = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_primitive_hive_miner_rare_crystals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_rare_crystals = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_primitive_hive_miner_engineering_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_engineering_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_primitive_hive_miner_energy = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_energy = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_primitive_hive_miner_physics_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_physics_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_primitive_hive_miner_society_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_society_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_primitive_hive_miner_trade = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_trade = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_primitive_hive_miner_consumer_goods = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_consumer_goods = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_primitive_hive_miner_unity = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_unity = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_primitive_hive_miner_exotic_gases = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_exotic_gases = yes }
        }
    }
}

            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_exotic_gases = yes }

            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_unity = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_primitive_hive_technician_consumer_goods = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_consumer_goods = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_primitive_hive_technician_trade = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_trade = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_primitive_hive_technician_society_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_society_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_primitive_hive_technician_physics_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_physics_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {

        }
        AND = {

        }

            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_alloys = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_primitive_technician_exotic_gases = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_exotic_gases = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_primitive_technician_unity = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_unity = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_primitive_technician_consumer_goods = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_consumer_goods = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_primitive_technician_trade = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_trade = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_primitive_technician_society_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_society_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_primitive_technician_physics_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_physics_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_primitive_technician_engineering_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_engineering_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_primitive_technician_food = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_food = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_primitive_technician_minerals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_minerals = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_primitive_technician_rare_crystals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_rare_crystals = yes }
        }
    }

bca_jr_should_dec_purge_processing_lithoid = {
    NOR = {
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_purge_processing_lithoid_minerals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_minerals = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_purge_processing_lithoid_unity = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_unity = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_purge_processing_lithoid_society_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_society_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_purge_processing_lithoid_physics_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_physics_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_purge_processing_lithoid_food = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_food = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_purge_processing_lithoid_consumer_goods = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_consumer_goods = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_purge_processing_lithoid_engineering_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_engineering_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_purge_processing_lithoid_rare_crystals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_rare_crystals = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_purge_processing_lithoid_energy = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_energy = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_purge_processing_lithoid_exotic_gases = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_exotic_gases = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_purge_processing_lithoid_alloys = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_alloys = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_purge_processing_lithoid_volatile_motes = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_volatile_motes = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_purge_processing_lithoid_trade = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_trade = yes }
        }
    }
}

bca_jr_should_dec_robot_caretaker = {
    NOR = {
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_robot_caretaker_unity = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_unity = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_robot_caretaker_engineering_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_engineering_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_robot_caretaker_society_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_society_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_robot_caretaker_trade = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_trade = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_robot_caretaker_rare_crystals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_rare_crystals = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_robot_caretaker_volatile_motes = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_volatile_motes = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_robot_caretaker_energy = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_energy = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_robot_caretaker_consumer_goods = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_consumer_goods = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_robot_caretaker_exotic_gases = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_exotic_gases = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_robot_caretaker_alloys = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_alloys = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_robot_caretaker_minerals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_minerals = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_robot_caretaker_food = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_food = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_robot_caretaker_physics_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_physics_research = yes }
        }
    }
}

bca_jr_should_dec_stasis_warden = {
    NOR = {
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_stasis_warden_unity = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_unity = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_stasis_warden_physics_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_physics_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_stasis_warden_alloys = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_alloys = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_stasis_warden_energy = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_energy = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_stasis_warden_consumer_goods = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_consumer_goods = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_stasis_warden_society_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_society_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_stasis_warden_food = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_food = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_stasis_warden_trade = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_trade = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_stasis_warden_engineering_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_engineering_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_stasis_warden_minerals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_minerals = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_stasis_warden_volatile_motes = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_volatile_motes = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_stasis_warden_exotic_gases = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_exotic_gases = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_stasis_warden_rare_crystals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_rare_crystals = yes }
        }
    }
}

bca_jr_should_dec_transference_drone = {
    NOR = {
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_transference_drone_unity = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_unity = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_transference_drone_physics_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_physics_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_transference_drone_food = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_food = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_transference_drone_consumer_goods = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_consumer_goods = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_transference_drone_engineering_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_engineering_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_transference_drone_rare_crystals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_rare_crystals = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_transference_drone_energy = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_energy = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_transference_drone_exotic_gases = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_exotic_gases = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_transference_drone_alloys = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_alloys = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_transference_drone_volatile_motes = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_volatile_motes = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_transference_drone_trade = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_trade = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_transference_drone_society_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_society_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_transference_drone_minerals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_minerals = yes }
        }
    }
}

            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_unity = yes }
        }

            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_society_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_treasure_gatherer_gestalt_trade = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_trade = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_treasure_gatherer_gestalt_engineering_research = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_engineering_research = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_treasure_gatherer_gestalt_rare_crystals = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_rare_crystals = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_treasure_gatherer_gestalt_volatile_motes = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_volatile_motes = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_treasure_gatherer_gestalt_consumer_goods = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_consumer_goods = yes }
        }
        AND = {
            bca_jr_has_output_treasure_gatherer_gestalt_exotic_gases = yes
            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_exotic_gases = yes }
        }
        AND = {

            NOT = { bca_empire_has_surplus_alloys = yes }
        }
        AND = {
